audience: support agents and helpdesk managers who handle tickets in Deskpro

useCases.title: List open tickets and who they are assigned to
useCases.text: The AI lists tickets filtered by status, agent, requester, organization, department or labels, so you see what is open and who owns each ticket.

useCases.title: Read the full conversation of a ticket
useCases.text: The AI opens a ticket and lists its messages, with replies, agent notes, authors and dates, then summarizes the issue and what was done.

useCases.title: Review the ticket history of a person or organization
useCases.text: The AI finds a person or an organization and lists their tickets, so you see how many were raised and what they are about.

useCases.title: Search the helpdesk and read knowledgebase articles
useCases.text: The AI searches across tickets, people, organizations, articles and more, then opens a knowledgebase article to read its content.

useCases.title: Open a ticket or change an existing one
useCases.text: The AI opens a ticket for a requester with a first message, or changes a ticket's status, agent, department, urgency or labels.

useCases.title: Add an internal note or reply to a ticket
useCases.text: The AI adds an internal agent note to a ticket, or sends a reply that the helpdesk emails to the requester.
